question: Which of the following was NOT a feature of the Green Revolution in India?

options.text: Increased use of fertilisers and irrigation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Expansion of agricultural land**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Green Revolution in India focused on increasing agricultural productivity by introducing new technologies rather than expanding agricultural land.
 
• It relied heavily on the use of high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds, chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and advanced irrigation techniques.
